note: boss phase 2: heavier, faster, more intense than phase 1
note_evidence: The distorted bass and fast tempo provide high intensity from 0:00, though the breakdown at 0:17 momentarily relieves the relentless pressure.
beat_evidence: A heavy, syncopated kick and snare pattern provides a highly tap-able, steady pulse right from 0:00.
loop_evidence: The track starts at full energy without a dead intro, but the structural breakdown from 0:17 to 0:24 introduces a lull that disrupts a steady loop.
